Vendored byte for byte from flux/defxn-defi-rs/dense-wire/web/ (main). Never edit a file here:
fix it at the source and copy it over. A drift test in this repo fails when any file differs
from the source.

Files: flx-domain-proof.mjs (the ONE shared DOM_PROOF verifier), and the files it imports:
flx-dumb-parser.mjs, flx-builders.mjs (and its flx-object-builders.mjs), flx-crypto.mjs; plus flx-wire.mjs (the WebSocket line
protocol client whose domProof() asks a node).

The set is derived, not listed by hand: every file reachable by import from flx-domain-proof.mjs,
flx-wire.mjs and flx-resolver-record-client.mjs (12 files on 2026-10-26).

Added 2026-10-26 for app release downloads (release.js): flx-resolver-record-client.mjs (lists
and decodes the bundle chain's KBUNDLE1 records) and the files it imports:
flx-identity-bridge.mjs, flx-launch-blobs.mjs, flx-record-grammar.mjs,
flx-resolver-artifacts.mjs, flx-state-grammar.js. The drift test's FILES list names all twelve.

package.json holds only "type": "module", as dense-wire/web/package.json does, so the .js files here
(flx-state-grammar.js) load as modules in Node the same way they do in a browser.
